title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Strip Map. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Strip Map
options.lineage: European rail strip maps above train doors, and station wayfinding signage
options.thesis: Your career is one line with stations; the visitor rides it from manual tester to manager of 24.
options.viewport: Name at signage scale left, real portrait right, the career line running full width at the fold with 'you are here' lit on Agentic QA; Get in touch beside the headline.
options.risk: A metro-map career page is a known portfolio trope; it only works if the line is a strict system, not a doodle.

raised.raise: Impact figures hold fixed digit places and roll per digit, like a departure board, never a blurred count-up.
Tones come from one numbered ramp only; no ad hoc tints anywhere.
Line behind the rider fills solid, line ahead stays dashed: scroll history is visible.
Every section is a numbered station with identical plate anatomy, read in order.
Dense stations alternate with quiet platforms: deliberate pacing gaps.

options.label: The Annual Report
options.thesis: The portfolio as an executive's annual report: key figures on the cover, the year in review inside.
options.viewport: Split cover: 3,500+ at poster scale on a deep field, name, role and the other three figures as a ruled key-figures table.
options.risk: Familiar: where most runs for an exec portfolio land, and the split hero edges toward template.

options.label: Street Typography
options.thesis: The claim shouted at architectural scale: MEASURED, cropped by the frame.
options.viewport: Yellow wall, MEASURED IN HOURS stacked and cropped, 3,500+ reversed on black, contact in the red-orange band.
options.case: Wins on clarity of the claim; loses on audience identification, too loud for a senior manager.
options.risk: Reads creative-agency, which you ruled out.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: Impact numbers glowing in tube banks.
options.viewport: Four tube banks, one per figure.
options.case: Dark glow is the look you ruled out; numbers read as gadget.
options.kept: Fixed digit places that roll per digit.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.viewport: Overlapping sheets over a zone ramp.
options.case: No link to QA leadership for recruiters.
options.kept: One numbered tonal ramp as the only tokens.

options.label: Couture Atelier
options.kept: Numbered plates with identical anatomy, read in order.

options.label: Plankton Wake
options.case: Dark neon, which you ruled out.
options.kept: Visible history: what you passed stays drawn.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.kept: Stacked blocks with deep gaps: pacing.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean leadership portfolio: title headline, photo, sections, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Role headline and Get in touch left, portrait right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other leadership portfolio by design.
